title: Bahasa Rasmi & Protokol
canDo: Address officials and dignitaries with correct titles
Give a brief formal welcome or vote-of-thanks speech
lifeBenefit: Handle the most formal register of Malay — official ceremonies, titles, and protocol.

vocab.example: Yang Berhormat Menteri akan berucap sebentar lagi.
vocab.exampleEn: The Honourable Minister will speak shortly.

vocab.example: Saya dijemput untuk sampaikan kata alu-aluan.
vocab.exampleEn: I've been invited to give the welcome address.

vocab.en: vote of thanks / speech of appreciation
vocab.exampleEn: He/she will deliver the vote of thanks.

vocab.example: Majlis rasmi ini dihadiri ramai tetamu.
vocab.exampleEn: This official event was attended by many guests.

vocab.en: respectfully / with due respect (formal letter/speech opener)

vocab.exampleEn: Please welcome our guest of honour.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'Please welcome the Honourable Minister, our guest of honour.'
practiceExercises.answer: Sila alu-alukan Yang Berhormat Menteri, tetamu kehormat kita.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'I have been invited to deliver the welcome address at this official event.'
practiceExercises.answer: Saya dijemput untuk menyampaikan kata alu-aluan pada majlis rasmi ini.

scenario.setting: Delivering a short formal welcome address at an official community event

script.ms: Mari kita sediakan kata alu-aluan untuk majlis rasmi esok.
script.en: Let's prepare the welcome address for tomorrow's official event.

script.ms: Baik. Macam mana saya patut mula ucapan?
script.en: Alright. How should I start the speech?

script.ms: Mula dengan 'Yang Berhormat, tetamu-tetamu kehormat, dan hadirin sekalian.'
script.en: Start with 'The Honourable, guests of honour, and distinguished attendees.'

script.ms: Selepas tu, saya sampaikan tujuan majlis?
script.en: After that, do I state the event's purpose?

script.ms: Ya, dan akhiri dengan ucapan penghargaan kepada semua yang hadir.
script.en: Yes, and end with a vote of thanks to everyone present.

scenario.aiPrompt: You are an AI coach helping the learner prepare a formal ceremonial welcome speech. Guide them through the correct formal openings, structure, and closing. Standard, highest-register Malay.

speakingPrompts.instructions: Shadow a full ceremonial welcome address, focusing on the very formal register and measured, dignified pace.
Work with the AI event-coach persona to prepare the opening lines of a formal speech for an occasion of your choice.
Deliver a 2-minute formal welcome address for an imagined official community event, using correct titles and closing with a vote of thanks.

questions.prompt: Translate: 'Respectfully, I wish to request permission.'
questions.answer: Dengan hormatnya, saya ingin memohon kebenaran.
